title: Google releases three new Gemini models — but no 3.5 Pro
slides: Google dropped three models—why no 3.5 Pro?
Gemini 2.5 Flash now handles 1M context tokens
Your multimodal chat suddenly costs 80% less
But your critical pipeline may still need Pro
Test your use case against each model today
thread_text:
1. Why no 3.5 Pro?

Google dropped three Gemini models at once, but skipped the mid-tier Pro — leaving developers guessing which one actually fits their pipeline.

2. 1M context for Flash

Gemini 2.5 Flash now processes a million tokens — enough to eat an entire codebase in one go. That changes how you build retrieval apps.

3. Multimodal costs crash

Real-time image and audio chats just got 80% cheaper on Flash. Your prototype no longer burns budget on every test message.

4. But Pro still rules

Your high‑stakes pipeline — compliance, review, chained reasoning — may break on Flash. Pro remains the safe fallback for critical paths.

5. Which model fits your flow?

Take a single prompt you already run in production. Run it on Flash, then on Pro. Measure output quality against latency — don't guess.
